# PreZero Landkreis Helmstedt (Gelbe Tonne)

Support for schedules provided by [PreZero Landkreis Helmstedt (Gelbe Tonne)](https://prezero.com/de/landkreis-helmstedt).

Gelbe Tonne waste collection schedule for Landkreis Helmstedt (PreZero Service Mitte).

## Configuration via configuration.yaml

```yaml
waste_collection_schedule:
  sources:
    - name: prezero_helmstedt_de
      args:
        municipality: MUNICIPALITY
        district: DISTRICT
```

### Configuration Variables

**municipality**  
*(string) (optional)*

**district**  
*(string) (required)*

## Example

```yaml
waste_collection_schedule:
  sources:
    - name: prezero_helmstedt_de
      args:
        municipality: Samtgemeinden Grasleben und Velpke
        district: Meinkot
```

## How to get the source arguments

Select your collection district (municipality) from the PreZero Landkreis Helmstedt schedule (https://prezero.com/de/landkreis-helmstedt) and enter your village/district or street.
